summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Placentia transient occupancy (hotel) tax from 10% to 14%.

tax.text: The Yes campaign supports increasing Placentia’s hotel tax from 10% to 14% to fund essential city services and infrastructure.
tax.quote: Vote YES on Placentia’s Hotel Tax Measure to protect essential city services, keep local dollars in Placentia, and ensure visitors pay their fair share.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the proposed hotel-tax increase from 10% to 14%.
tax.quote: A NO vote rejects the ordinance, and would leave the Hotel Tax at 10%.
